description: Discover the best hotels in Hoi An, Vietnam. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Hoi An Riverside Serenity with Massages, Daily Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner & Cocktails
hotels.description: Welcome to Bellerive Hoi An Resort and Spa, where a gentle riverside setting is matched by an upscale beach‑chic aesthetic just steps from the oceanfront. Waiting inside is a sprawling palm-fringed pool, the heavenly Shanti Spa and a range of bars and eateries to indulge in. Start your days in Roma Ristorante, serving up a mouthwatering BBQ buffet, or head to Cocolangal for all-day dining in a vibrant setting. Evenings are best spent with a cocktail in hand at the Pool Bar Terrace, or unwinding with a soothing treatment at the spa. Beyond the resort, a complimentary shuttle service brings you to the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An Ancient Town, with its tailor shops, riverside cafes and Japanese Covered Bridge. The hotel’s location on the banks of the Thu Bon River offers tranquil views and easy access to boat tours exploring the lush countryside and nearby craft villages.

hotels.vendor_name: Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort & Wellness
hotels.title: Hoi An Beachfront Retreat with Lush Wellness Spa
hotels.description: Bask in the luxury of Bliss Hoi An Beach Resort & Wellness, located alongside the picturesque Binh Minh beach. This hidden gem is a wellness paradise, enveloped by lush tropical gardens and direct beach access and offering high-quality spa treatments and revitalising yoga and Tai Chi classes. Savour the finest Vietnamese delicacies at the exclusive restaurant and embark on private tours to discover the hidden gems of Hoi An and its ancient surroundings.

hotels.title: Romantic Hoi An Riverfront Retreat with Massages, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Free-Flow Drinks Hour
hotels.description: An escape to Hoi An’s enchanting Ancient Town beckons with a stay at this elegant retreat, where Vietnamese charm meets refined Art Nouveau design. Just steps from the Thu Bon River and the lantern-lit lanes of the UNESCO-listed Old Town, this sanctuary blends cultural discovery with five-star comfort, boasting romantic decor inspired by the 17th‑century love story of Japanese merchant Sotaro and Vietnamese Princess Wakaku. Make the most of the hotel’s premium facilities with endless laps in the rooftop pool, indulgent spa treatments and delectable dining. Savour mouthwatering Japanese at Wakaku or opt for local flavours at Faifo Cafe before enjoying sunset tipples at one of three onsite bars. Spend days cycling over bridges and let the lantern-lit rivers guide your travels. Find yourself at the night market browsing hundreds of diverse vendors, stumble upon charming tea houses and lose yourself among the city’s age-old facades. End each day in paradise by ascending to The Deck - the highest rooftop bar and lounge in Hoi An - where spectacular views of the Thu Bon River beckon.

hotels.title: Five-Star Hoi An Opulence on Hoai River with Restaurant, Bar & Pool with Ancient Town Views
hotels.description: Retreat to the banks of the Hoai River at this enchanting escape designed to embrace the very best of this vibrant Vietnamese town. With hints of local architecture intertwined with sleek modern features, this charming hotel is the perfect riverside abode, just minutes from the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Hoi An Ancient Town. Savour Mediterranean flavours at the onsite restaurant, sip cocktails by the pool and take a moment of rest at Breathe Spa - here, there's no reason to rush.

hotels.vendor_name: Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa
hotels.title: Hoi An Oceanfront Serenity with Onsite Dining, Outdoor Pool & Private Beach
hotels.description: Step through traditional Vietnamese doors to discover this serene retreat where a sprawling pool flows among palm-fringed gardens, framed by a long stretch of pristine private beach. Lose track of time while gliding through the water on a kayak, escape to the ultra-tranquil Victoria Spa for a treatment or catch a film at the onsite cinema. Savour Asian and European dishes at the L’Annam Restaurant, unwind poolside with a tropical tipple from Faifo Bar or enjoy a game of billiards at Elephant Bar. When it’s time to venture into town, the quaint streets and canals of the UNESCO heritage-listed Hoi An Ancient Town are just 15-minutes away.

hotels.vendor_name: Wyndham Hoi An Beachfront Resort & Villas
hotels.title: Hoi An Beachfront Haven with Gourmet Dining, Rooftop Bar, Infinity Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Experience the magic of Vietnam’s ancient town with a five-star stay at Wyndham Hoi An Royal Beachfront Resort & Villas. Set on the pristine shores of the South China Sea, this luxurious resort is a tranquil oasis located on the golden sands between Da Nang and the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Hoi An Old Town. Sink your toes into the soft sand of An Bang Beach, where you’ll have a front-row seat to golden sunrises, and enjoy the resort’s state-of-the-art facilities, including the tranquil Royal Retreat Spa and sprawling infinity pool. Treat your palate to authentic Vietnamese cuisine at the resort's many onsite restaurants, or venture out to explore the vibrant local food scene at Hoi An Night Market. Take a leisurely bike ride through the lush rice fields, visit the historic Japanese Covered Bridge, or explore the colourful lantern-lit streets of Hoi An’s Old Town before heading back to the resort for a nightcap at Chill Sky Bar.

hotels.vendor_name: Wyndham Hoi An Beachfront Resort & Villas
hotels.title: Hoi An Private Pool Villa Bliss with Massages, Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Club Lounge Access
hotels.description: Experience a magical slice of Vietnam's coastline with a five-star stay at Wyndham Hoi An Royal Beachfront Resort & Villas. Set on the pristine shores of the South China Sea, this luxurious resort is a tranquil oasis, gracefully located on the golden sands between Da Nang and the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Hoi An Old Town. Sink your toes into the soft sand of An Bang Beach, where you’ll have a front-row seat to golden sunrises, and enjoy the resort’s state-of-the-art facilities, including the tranquil Sense Spa and sprawling infinity pool. Treat your palate to authentic Vietnamese cuisine at the resort’s onsite restaurant, or venture out to explore the vibrant local food scene at Hoi An’s night market. The resort’s prime location also puts you within easy reach of the region’s top attractions. Take a leisurely bike ride through the lush rice fields, visit the historic Japanese Covered Bridge, or explore the colourful lantern-lit streets of Hoi An’s Old Town before heading back to the resort for a nightcap at Sky Bar.
